daten.text:
The Kill Switch is a recent feature added to Dead by Daylight. It gives us the ability to temporarily switch off any items/offerings/maps/cosmetics/characters that are causing game breaking issues in the game, to ensure continued enjoyment. When the Kill Switch is used, the item/offering/cosmetic/character/map will not be able to be selected. Maps are automatically removed from rotation, and they will remain unable to be selected in Custom Games.
On this page, you can find information on what is currently disabled through the Kill Switch, in game, along with the reason why and when you can expect them to return. We also list current Known Issues here, but they remain enabled.

Kill Switch (Disabled)
• Due to an issue affecting an area of the Grim Pantry map, it has been Kill Switched. It will be re-enabled in a future patch.
• The Krasue's Overgrowth cosmetic has been temporarily disabled in the store and inventories due to crashing. Those who unlocked the cosmetic will still have it when the issue has been resolved.

Known Issues that are marked with a targeted fix date are not guaranteed. However, we will endeavour to apply these fixes at that time.
For those Under Investigation, the issue is still being resolved and we do not have a fix date to communicate as yet.
